_why: The one exit in the bank, and it is opt-in on purpose: across both torn-down references a title goes from full to gone in a single frame, so an element that dissolves is a decision, never a default. Shorter than any entrance, which is what editing convention says an exit should be.
_measured: Not measured off a reference: these are the durations motion design uses at 30 fps (150 ms = 5 frames, 250 = 8, 400 = 12, 600 = 18), chosen off the effects sheet rendered 2026-09-13. A verdict on the sheet replaces them. REFERENCES.md: exits are hard cuts; the only measured ramps out are a colour tint (~30 frames) and the caption layer lingering ~4 frames past a cut.
